title: Branching for General Relativists
version: Published chapter in T. Müller (ed.), Nuel Belnap on Indeterminism and Free Action, Outstanding Contributions to Logic 2 (2014), pp.191–221; DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-01754-9_10
locator: Original chapter PDF: introduction p.192; §4.1 Definition 15 pp.200–201, Definition 17 p.201, Condition 18 and Definitions 19–23 pp.202–203; §6 pp.217–218.
assumptions: Generalized BST model has nonempty base W with a pre-order and patches; each patch has a nonempty dense partial order satisfying Definition 15 clauses 2(a)–(d), with coverage and overlap-order agreement. Generalized histories are maximal consistent subsets determined through local splitting pairs. Clause 2(a) uses the usual maximal-chain principle (choice); its interval condition is t_{>x}∩t_{<y}. The checked chain proof is conditional on nonempty chains; Definition15 does not explicitly state this exclusion, unlike Definition1. Source convention remains an open qualification.
conclusion: The global common-upper-bound condition on standard BST histories is replaced by local splitting-pair consistency. For W=(0,2π)×S³ with the exact closed-dust causal order and one patch O={W}, direct order-geometric reasoning establishes Definition 15's checked conditions; uniqueness of chain least upper bounds prevents distinct splitting pairs, so W is the sole generalized history. Later manifold and tangent-space conditions are not checked.
proof_status: Selected primary clauses read directly. The project-side correspondence is proved in RESULT.md using the exact causal-order inequality Δτ≥dₛ₃, compactness/completeness of S³, and explicit endpoint-limit arguments; no full source-paper proof audit is claimed. Coordinator also rendered original p200 to resolve strict >x in clause2a; source scan checked directly.
dependencies: Closed-dust conformal metric recorded in the adjacent coordinator result; no independent cosmology-source audit in this task.
relevance: Tests and closes the precise Definition 15 2(a)–(c) correspondence question for one closed-dust spacetime with its exact causal order.
limits: Specific to the conformal cylinder and exact causal order. Does not construct or verify Placek's later topology, manifold charts, connectedness/countability postulates, or tangent spaces. No broad GR coverage, novelty, or ontological claim. If empty chains are included, Definition15(2b,c) fail for the candidate; hence correspondence is explicitly conditional on nonempty chains.
